subject: Mathematics
question_text: Q21. Let A={2,3,4,5,6}. A relation R on A x A is defined by (x,y)R(z,w) iff x divides z and y<=w. Find the number of elements in R.
solution: There are 8 ordered pairs (x,z) in A squared with x dividing z and 15 ordered pairs (y,w) with y<=w. Therefore |R|=8*15=120.

subject: Mathematics
question_text: Q22. Let A=[[2,-2],[4,-2]] and B=[[3,9],[1,3]]. If PA=B and AQ=B, find the absolute value of the sum of the diagonal elements of 2(P+Q).
solution: P=BA^-1 and Q=A^-1B. By cyclic invariance of trace, tr(P)=tr(Q)=tr(A^-1B)=-17/2. Thus |tr(2(P+Q))|=34.
